title: First Time on a Swamp Kayak Tour

slides.headline: Never kayaked? Good. That's most of our guests.
10 to 15 minutes on dry land first
slides.body: Paddle grip, getting in and out, what the life jacket does. Then practice strokes in shallow water.

slides.headline: Rare. Calm water, stable kayaks.
slides.body: Stable sit-in models on a cypress swamp with barely a current. 400+ tours and nobody has tipped yet.

slides.headline: Common. Not guaranteed.
slides.body: Unfed gators avoid you, which is why we never bait them. Spot one close? Stay calm, keep paddling.

slides.headline: Life jacket on the whole tour.
slides.body: Guide included. Most of the swamp is shallow enough to stand in, and guides are CPR-certified.

slides.headline: Stable kayak. Gators keep distance. Life jacket on.
slides.body: Tell your guide you're nervous. That's the whole plan.

slides.headline: Ready to stop worrying?
slides.body: 2-hour Manchac swamp tour. 12 guests max. Send this to the friend who's nervous.
